flash_loan_obtained.meaning: attacker has obtained flash-loaned tokens used to manipulate the Uniswap V2 pool

pool_spot_price_manipulated.meaning: Uniswap V2 pool spot price is manipulated before buyBack() is called

twap_distinct_from_spot.meaning: validatePrice() computes a timeWeightedAverage that is distinct from the current spot tradePrice, so the maxSlippage deviation check is meaningful

protocol_funds_lost.meaning: protocol funds are lost to a sandwich attack during the buyBack swap

assumptions: buyBack() is callable by the attacker in the reported scenario.
The flash-loan and pool-manipulation steps are treated as the attack narrative preceding the buyBack() call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether buyBack() is permissionless or restricted, so attacker access to trigger the swap is not explicitly established.

Report does not give numeric maxSlippage, TWAP, or spot-price values, so the deviation-beyond-maxSlippage relation is represented only by the qualitative twap_distinct_from_spot and fund-loss observables.

limitations: Only the protocol_loses_funds impact is formalized; validatePrice() always returning true and unfavorable swap rate are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
The TWAP-distinct-from-spot and fund-loss observables are qualitative because the report supplies no numeric price or slippage quantities.
